changelog:
- Initial release of sol-quick-hits.
- Generates a daily weekday AI briefing with 3 curated stories from Hacker News and dev.to.
- Summaries are written in Sol's voice using MiniMax.
- Automatically creates and publishes Jekyll posts to GitHub.
- Requires API key and specific local repo paths for setup.
- Runs every weekday at 8am UK time.
summary: Weekday AI briefing — fetches top AI stories from Hacker News and dev.to, generates a 3-item curated briefing post in Sol's voice.
